title: 48:10 refined/furnace of affliction. In the process of refining metals, intense heat is used to burn off the grosser elements and impurities. The initial furnace of affliction for Israel was her servitude in Egypt (Deut. 4:20; 1 Kgs. 8:51). In all eras, the Saints are to be refined and made like Christ through affliction as metal is refined in the burning furnace. Though affliction is the furnace in which we will be refined, Christ is the refiner (Zech. 13:9; Mal. 3:2-3), cleansing our hearts and souls so that we can enter the Father's kingdom (3 Ne. 27:19-20). Those who are so refined are then chosen.
author: Tina M. Peterson
